svg.title: apool v2 allocator diagram
svg.desc: One mapping of 16 KiB pages and 32 B page records; size classes own lists of pages; free blocks inside a page form an encoded free list; empty pages stay warm, then return their memory.
svg.text: Scope: one pool (the task pool, 8 MiB) · quicx/src/apool.c, 341 lines of C
[mmap once · 8,339,328 B · never grown, never moved]
no block headers: a block's page is
a size owns only the pages it needs right now
freed block 4: its first 8 B point to the next free block
free list in the page · mimalloc 2019
> 63 warm: the oldest gives memory back
≤ 7 free: only a size with no page
page in use (finer grid = smaller blocks)
